newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasuries up again, buying on dips continues.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries up again, buying on dips continues.

text.p: *U.S. Treasuries up again as trend of buying on dips continues
*Decline after big 42,000 drop in jobless claims short-lived,
as Treasury mkt off report as having too much noise.
*Hedge fund, foreign buying in intermediate sector reported
*Quiet day seen, but hedging and swapping of corporates likely
